service_map.reason: Kibana 9.5.2 displays a Platinum-license requirement for the APM service map; the runtime license probe enables this pack on Platinum, Enterprise, or trial installations.

slo.reason: The pinned local Basic license returns HTTP 403 and requires Platinum or higher; the runtime probe enables this pack on licensed installations.

maps.reason: Extension feasibility must be confirmed against local map assets.

synthetics.reason: Extension requires compatible Synthetics result documents and UI verification.

machine_learning.reason: Extension requires a machine-learning subscription and job APIs.

notes: Core learner workflows are read-only; controller APIs create and clean up resources.
APM traces and infrastructure support are verified through adapter contracts and must be rechecked if the pinned Stack version changes.
The service-map and SLO packs remain in the target core curriculum but are unavailable on the default Basic license; capability probing enables them when licensed.
Optional extensions remain unavailable until an environment probe and end-to-end test pass.
